title: Left-orderability in Dehn fillings of pseudo-Anosov mapping tori
summary: For pseudo-Anosov mapping tori with co-orientable invariant foliations and monodromies reversing their co-orientations, a family of taut foliations was constructed in previous work on Dehn fillings with all rational slopes outside a neighborhood of the degeneracy slope. In this paper, we prove that all such Dehn fillings have left-orderable fundamental groups. We present two approaches, both establishing left-orderability through the branching behavior of taut foliations.
